prompt:
fix(naming): four shipped strings named a command this package does not install

The package ships one binary, `simt`, and package.json's bin map says so. Four
places still said `simt-dev`, and a reader who typed what the tool told them to
type got `unknown command` back - from the very help that printed it:

  - output/index.mjs   the default remedy on every EXIT.USAGE, `simt-dev --help`
  - commands/help.mjs  `usage: simt-dev <command>`, above a list that spells `simt`
  - ci/dependabot.mjs  `Yours from here: simt-dev`, where the gate beside it says
                       `Yours from here: simt`
  - hooks/shim.mjs     `simt-dev on PATH`, directly above the `command -v simt`
                       that does the looking, in the shim every adopted repo reads

This is the repository's own rule and not a new one: every byte that leaves here
must be actionable by someone holding only the receiving repository, and a command
that does not exist under the name the package ships is the un-actionable case.

test/naming.test.mjs existed for exactly this and passed. Its rule was "the project
name followed by a verb", and none of the four is followed by one - the guard asked
one shape of the question and read every other shape as prose. It now also catches
a flag, a <placeholder>, the end of a line, and a program name inside a resolution
list, and it still accepts the sentences where the project is the subject
("Canonical X rule managed by simt-dev"), because that spelling is correct and a
guard nobody tolerates gets deleted rather than widened.

The dependabot string is deliberately NOT a spelling rule. "Yours from here:
simt-dev" is a grammatical sentence about the project, and no suffix rule separates
it from prose that is right. What it actually did was disagree with the other
template in the same commit, in the same position, for the same reader - so the
assertion is on the agreement: both .github templates hand over the same command.

Four mutations, each reverting one string to its shipped form, each caught; three
by two tests. Suite is 751/751 from a copy at a path with no siblings (ADR-031).
